The immutable Hub package is the public Hub SDK and CLI packed (`npm pack`) from AgentOrg `4e795ee6af3af64fd526bfdfcf790b15156295a8`: `@agentorg/cli` 0.0.1, the Hub's first release, with Workspace 0.0.1 ([AgentOrg PRs 73](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/73) and [74](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/74)). Once it is on npm, this archive is the same bytes the registry serves. The authoritative Tool descriptions are used without a local override.

`agentorg-cli-4e795ee.tgz` has SHA256 `ff8ef123bb3422c361eff356d9c9cbb07aac267ca68ca467c344f5db0339fbb1`. Production imports only its public `@agentorg/cli/contract` schemas/types. Tests additionally launch its public `agentorg-server` command against an owned temporary home and use exported Actor APIs. No sibling checkout or private server/storage imports are used.

The Hub bundles `@uniac/agentic-workspace` 0.0.1, at source `4f696a5`: asks on Work, routed to the asker's manager and raised one manager up, answered with `work_answer`; approvals answered only by the asker's managers; submissions answered by their requester; and Messages in their pair's conversation. The full Hub catalog has 8 Tools and 21 interfaces, each tagged with its level; 8 are at the Report level. Test fixtures always use new empty homes.
